title: Global Well-Posedness and Energy Decay for an Abstract Viscoelastic Wave Equation with Nonlocal or Friction Damping
summary: This paper investigates an abstract viscoelastic wave equation in a separable Hilbert space, in which the damping term depends on a power of the velocity norm. Depending on whether the power exponent is zero or nonzero, this damping corresponds to friction damping or nonlocal damping, respectively; the equation also contains a viscoelastic damping represented by an integral term with a relaxation function. We establish global well-posedness for initial data in \(\mathcal{H}_1\) by combining monotone operator theory with the Faedo--Galerkin method, and prove uniqueness for all exponents…
